coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: Only generic employer pages (non-official, undated): employer must register an employee with INSS within 15 days of hire; monthly withholding to OBR and INSS. No domestic-worker-specific regime found. Nothing candidate-grade; unverified.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: Budget; no search run.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: Budget; no search run.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: Searched with mining (cat 27). Gold exports rose from about 400 kg (2024) to 1.2 t (2025) per IMF. Mineral bags need an OBM label before export and exporters must surrender forex to BRB (Iwacu). No jewellery-buyer rules found. See comptoir candidate.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: Budget; no search run.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: Budget; K09 already covers livestock movement certificates (rejected).

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: Budget; no search run.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: Budget; no search run.

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: Loi 1/06 of 21 Mar 2011 (vet profession; 5 establishment types incl. vet pharmacy; registration with the Ordre) and loi 1/05 of 11 Feb 2021 (vet products). ABREVPA created by decree 100/083 of 4 Jul 2022. No licence-renewal, reporting or enforcement detail found.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: Budget; no search run.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: Budget; no search run.

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: Budget; no search run. Likely tiny market.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: Budget; no search run.

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: Loi 1/08 of 11 May 2018 on pesticide management (national approval committee, inspection). Subsidised fertiliser runs through vouchers redeemed by suppliers and refunded by the ministry; BRIDEP is tendering a firm to digitise this (EOI deadline Aug 2026), so the state is the buyer. FOMI dominates fertiliser supply. No dealer licensing procedure found.

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: Budget; only touched via cat 26 security results.

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: Budget; no search run.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: Budget; K04 already covers religious-body foreign-donation declarations.

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: Only dated material: moto-taxis, bicycle taxis and tuk-tuks banned from central Bujumbura in March 2022; plate and vest schemes of unknown current status. No current licensing or inspection regime found.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Budget; K07 already covers forex bureaux (rejected).

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Budget; no search run.

coverage.category: 21. Fuel stations and fuel or LPG distributors
coverage.found: Interpetrol's monopoly was removed and the sector went to Regideso plus private Prestige; shortages persist (HRW 2025). SOPEBU is digitising vehicles that buy fuel. About 1 station per 57,554 inhabitants, so few small dealers. No station licence or reporting duty found.

coverage.category: 22. Grain, coffee, cocoa and other commodity traders, millers and warehouses
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K01. Searches returned only old structure material (SOGESTAL defunct, CNAC 130,000 households). EUDR date and Burundi-specific EUDR readiness not confirmed.

coverage.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
coverage.found: COOPECs/FENACOBU under decree 100/203 of 2006 and BRB Regulation 001/2018; auditor circular 10/M/18 sets a 31 March reporting date. E-money circular 001/SP/2024. No 2025 microfinance law found. See COOPEC candidate.

coverage.category: 24. Private clinics, labs and other health providers that bill insurers or state schemes
coverage.found: Only old (2007-2014) sources on MFP (civil-service scheme) billing: hospital acts at official tariffs, lab exams at negotiated rates. Nothing current on private-provider billing.

coverage.category: 25. Pharmacies, medicine importers, and users of controlled chemicals or precursors
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K02. OBR announced the ABREMA web module of the e-single window live on 17 Feb 2026, mandatory from 18 Feb 2026 for pharma import requests. ABREMA fee order 630/540/134 of 29 Jan 2024. No pharmacy or wholesaler licensing or inspection detail found.

coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: Guard firms need an operating permit from the Interior/Security ministry (MONUSCO, BANCOBU tenders require a valid one). Clients hold the provider responsible for social security declarations and work-accident insurance. Many guards are hired directly by owners. No procedure or enforcement detail found.

coverage.category: 27. Construction, mining and quarry contractors and suppliers: site registers, accreditation, local-content reports
coverage.found: Mining side only. OBM (Office burundais des mines et carrières) controls extraction to export; 2013 orders set annual contributions for artisanal sites, quarries and comptoirs; cooperatives get ministerial ordinances. Nothing on construction site registers or local content.

coverage.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports
coverage.found: Search returned only French, Belgian and Burkinabe material. Burundi's AML law, list of obliged professions and FIU rules not found.

coverage.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals: guest registers, tourism levies
coverage.found: No guest-register or tourism-levy rule found. Hotels were classified under an EAC framework (Iwacu 2019). Under the insurance code, hotels taking at least 15 guests must hold fire/explosion liability insurance (see cat 33).

coverage.category: 30. Small exporters and importers facing traceability or certification rules: food, fish, timber, forest-risk commodities
coverage.found: Customs runs on SYDONIA with licensed customs brokers (old sources). OBR e-single window (GUE) web version launched Feb 2026. A secondary source says importers must hold an approved e-invoicing system from July 2026 (unconfirmed). Nothing new for fish or timber.

coverage.category: 31. Mobile money and bank commercial agents (BRB Regulation 003/2024, circular 001/SP/2024)
coverage.found: BRB Regulation 003/2024 (dated 30 Jul or 1 Sep 2024, unconfirmed) governs commercial agents in banking and payment services: agent approval, risk management, periodic compliance reports. E-money circular 001/SP/2024 covers distributors. Texts not read.

coverage.category: 32. Telecom equipment distributors and SIM sellers (ARCT order 580/01 of 2025; SIM registration 2026)
coverage.found: ARCT order 580/01: distributors need ARCT authorisation, national register of approved products, fines up to BIF 5M plus confiscation. SIM re-registration began mid-June 2026 (in person with ID; no formal agent-registration duty stated; operators keep data 5 years).

coverage.category: 33. Compulsory insurance for commercial premises (Code des assurances arts 277-287, loi 1/06 of 2020)
coverage.found: Fire/explosion liability insurance is compulsory for discos, bars and restaurants of at least 250 m2, hotels of at least 15 guests, shops of at least 200 m2, cinemas, theatres and casinos. ARCA ran field checks in 2017, 2018, 2022, 2023 and Feb-May 2024 and found most operators ignorant of the law. Sanctions and proof-of-cover form not found.

coverage.category: 34. OBR electronic invoicing (MFE) for small taxpayers
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K06/K03/K08. MFE costs BIF 1,206,345 (up to 12 instalments). OBR January 2026 magazine calls taxpayers above BIF 25M turnover to obtain one; small-taxpayer deadline unconfirmed.

coverage.category: 35. Subsidised fertiliser voucher scheme (suppliers, microfinance institutions)
coverage.found: Farmers register through an approved MFI, pay a 40% share, and redeem vouchers at suppliers who are refunded by the ministry. BRIDEP (AfDB/IFAD, USD 323.75M, 2024-2029) is procuring digitisation of the scheme and geolocation of 120,000 households. The state is the buyer.

coverage.category: 36. Customs brokers and transit agents (OBR)
coverage.found: Only old SYDONIA++ material (2006, 2008, 2016). Current accreditation list and rules not found; new GUE web platform since Feb 2026.

coverage.category: 37. Insurance brokers and general agents (ARCA)
coverage.found: ARCA publishes lists of approved brokerage companies and professional-card holders; the brokers' association is IBAB. Conditions and reporting duties not found.

coverage.category: 38. Artisanal mining comptoirs and gold exporters (OBM)
coverage.found: OBM labels mineral bags before export; exporters must surrender forex to BRB; 2013 orders set comptoir contributions. EITI status and current comptoir rules not found.
